name: weread-exporter
description: Export WeRead books that the user is authorized to read to Markdown with inline images.

interface.shortDescription: Export authorized WeRead books to Markdown
interface.longDescription: Runs a local Playwright workflow to export a book the user is authorized to read, preserving text and inline illustrations in Markdown.
interface.defaultPrompt: Export this WeRead reader URL to Markdown in a folder I choose.
